workflow_runs.display_title: 📖 Linguist: optimize Trie-regex compilation & casing lookup

head_commit.message:
📖 Linguist: optimize Trie-regex compilation & casing lookup

- Implement Trie-structured regex generation for CedrLang document
  translation and 1337speak phase codec patterns.
- Pre-compute casing variant lookup tables at module initialization.
- Synchronize AGENTS.hum.md human-readable documentation with AGENTS.md.
- Record critical performance insights in .jules/Linguist.md.
